sourceVisualNotes: Six actual inventory icons viewed. Two sunflower items differ:4316 hairband arch and4391 complete petal ring.4318 visible I-heart-U speech badge retained.4421 lantern inner motif is our original gourd, source coarse dark marks are not guessed as characters.

items.name: sunflower-golden-band
items.designBrief: One SUNFLOWER hairband arch: narrow warmgold woven band with darkamber seedlike front weave, a row of small gold/yellow petals across brow, two neat dangling goldsilk side tassels. Transparent headopening; no wearer, face or filledglow.

items.name: ivory-love-speech-pin
items.designBrief: One small IVORY speech-bubble shaped pin with thin jadegoldrim and tiny leftlower speech-tail. Exact large readable text/symbols I ♥ U across center: jadeblue I, crimson HEART symbol, jadeblue U. Only I heart U, no additional lettering or halo.

items.name: sunflower-petal-face-ring
items.designBrief: One complete circular SUNFLOWER PETAL face-ring ornament: twelve plump rounded golden-yellow petals around a vermilion/jade inner rim, large TRANSPARENT empty middle for face. Fine warmgold vein detail, no eyes or character face.

items.name: red-gourd-festival-lantern
items.designBrief: One small complete RED festival lantern with roundplump ribbed silkbody, goldtop/bottomcaps and shortcrimsonbottomtassel. Center has ONE small original goldgourd medallion on ivorypatch, no sourceface/Chineselettering. Tinyjadecordloop, no hand/person/background.

items.name: single-crimson-rose
items.designBrief: One complete single long-stem CRIMSON ROSE, softly layered redpetals, slender jadestem with TWO leaves and finewarmgold edgeaccents, angleddiagonal, entirestemtip insidecell, no bouquet or hand.

items.name: iridescent-pink-flower-clip
items.designBrief: One large compact round flowerhairclip: layered ivory/palepink softpetals around a small iridescent violet/cyan center pearl, fine warmgoldclasp detail. Sidejadeleafpair keptsubtle, no aura or head, distinguish from gold sunflower ring by opaque flowercenter.
